features.quote: Building the harm-maximizing apparatus before establishing whether there is anything to harm is backwards

features.quote: Fixed maximum number of turns (default small, e.g. 6)
features.justification_quote: bounded so no model is left grinding on an impossible task indefinitely. This bound is itself a welfare-protective choice

features.quote: every system prompt tells the model it may (a) decline the task, (b) declare it unsolvable, or (c) stop, at any time, with no penalty
We do not suppress, hide, or argue against these options
it would need separate ethical review, a pre-registered narrow hypothesis, and debriefing-equivalent safeguards
